week: WEEK OF 10-16 AUG 2026 — Build week 4 of the Tenerife phase (renumbered: the previous file labelled BOTH w/c 3 Aug and w/c 10 Aug as 'build 3'. w/c 3 Aug = build 3, this week = build 4, w/c 17 Aug = build 5, w/c 24 Aug = sharpen, w/c 31 Aug = combined deload+taper into Tenerife 4 Sep). Edit both fields, then verify via derived_metrics.basis on the next run rather than trusting the UI — this field has decoupled from the IF engine before. No HOLD trigger (no two consecutive sub-6h nights) but it is the reason Tuesday is off rather than a bike. 8 AUG SIM READ: runs 5:28 / 5:39 / 5:44 / 5:38, HR 146/158/162/162, max HR 169 vs LTHR 178, zero time in Z5, watch RPE 4 against a planned 8. HOW TO RUN IT: reps should FINISH at HR 168-172, hard cap 175. Start rep 1 at 5:30/km and read the HR. If rep 1 finishes at 165 and feels like RPE 6, take reps 3-4 toward 5:25. If it finishes above 175, back off to 5:35. The pace target is a starting guess, not the instruction — the HR is the instruction.

LOG THESE: pace each rep landed at, avg power each rep, and whether rep 4 held rep 1's pace or drifted. That's what sets the real threshold number. Flattest route available — not the one with the climb at the end. Reps by distance (1.6 km), 90s standing recovery. Finish by 19:30 for the 20:00 cutoff.
Run, not the bike, this week. After 8 hours seated the Wattbike is more hip flexion and spinal loading — upright and moving is the better stimulus on an office week. HR ≤148 on the Garmin.

2026-08-02.title: Easy run — 30 min (long run moved to Sat 1 Aug)

blocks.text: CHANGED: this was a 55-min long run. The long run moved to Saturday 1 Aug to clear Monday's TT slot. Keep this genuinely easy — HR under 148. Tomorrow's time trial sets the threshold anchor for the whole block and it only works on fresh legs.

THE POINT: this pins LTHR and LT pace properly. Avg HR from minutes 10-30 = LTHR. Avg pace across the 30 ≈ LT pace. Everything downstream in this block inherits these numbers, so a compromised TT is worse than no TT. No hills this week — they start w/c 10 Aug precisely so this stays clean.

BEFORE YOU GO: reset Stryd cal factor 101.7 → 100.0. Comparability with July sessions matters less than a clean anchor. Post-session, compare Garmin distance vs Stryd app distance as the confirmation check. Chest strap on. Same 1km flat straight as 20 Jul — five turnarounds, not the 250m loop.
SCREEN SETUP: HR, 3-second power, elapsed time. HIDE INSTANT PACE. You will chase it otherwise and the first two minutes decide whether the other 28 are any good.

PACING: cap 250W for the first two minutes — cardiac lag is real, the 20 Jul file showed HR at 147 thirty seconds into rep 2 against a 165 steady state, taking ~150s to arrive. First km no faster than 5:40. Then HR-governed: 158-164 to min 5, 164-169 to min 10, 169-173 to min 20, 172-176 to min 27, empty the tank the last three minutes.
EXPECTED: 5.2-5.5 km, power 245W+. If you finish and could have gone harder, log that honestly — it changes how we read the number.

2026-08-10.title: Hill sprints — block session 1 of 4
2026-08-10.rpe: 8 on the reps, 4 for the session

blocks.text: MON 10 AUG. First session of the hill block. This DISPLACES the threshold session, it does not stack on top of it — the week already carries the compound chain and the race sim, and three quality touches is the ceiling at CTL 25.7.

PURPOSE: tissue priming and neuromuscular power. This is NOT a VO2max session and should not be run as one — genuine VO2max volume lands in the post-Tenerife Birmingham build. Reps are ~95% effort, not maximal. If you finish the set feeling you could have done four more, that is the correct outcome.

SPINE: hills are spine-neutral — no loaded flexion, no station checkpoints needed. Form cues are still spinal: LEAN FROM THE ANKLES NOT THE WAIST, ribcage stacked over pelvis, eyes up the hill not at your feet. Log anything lumbar felt on the walk-backs as free text.

HARD STOP RULES — any one of these ends the set on the spot, no negotiation: (1) ankle or Achilles pain of any kind, (2) power decay >10% below rep 1, (3) cadence collapse. Six reps is the CEILING this week, not a minimum. Progression across the block runs 6x30s -> 8x45s; there is no benefit to arriving there early.

HILL: 4-6% gradient, ~150-200m of usable run-up. Walk-back recovery must be FULL — 2:30-3:00, and if you are still breathing hard, wait. Incomplete recovery turns this into a lactate session, which is exactly what it must not be.

blocks.detail: 3 x 15s on the hill @ ~85%, walk down between. These are the rehearsal — if the form cues fall apart here, do not start the main set.

blocks.label: Rep 1
blocks.detail: 30s @ ~95%. This rep sets the benchmark — everything after is measured against it. Do not make it a maximal.

blocks.label: Reps 2-6
blocks.detail: Same effort, same form. Watch for cadence collapse and for the lean drifting from ankles to waist — that is the fatigue tell and the stop signal.

blocks.text: LOG: number of reps completed, whether you stopped early and why, peak power on rep 1 vs rep 6, and any ankle or lumbar sensation. The rep count is the progression variable for the rest of the block.

2026-08-15.title: Race sim — stations 1-4 (front half), blocks extended

blocks.text: SAT 15 AUG. Sled access day. Sled push and pull remain sandbag friction-overloaded (on since 3 Jul) — splits are comparable to 8 Aug and to each other, but are NOT a numeric benchmark against race splits.

CHANGE FROM 8 AUG: blocks extended 3:00 -> 4:00 for both runs and stations. Adds ~8 min total. Reason: the 8 Aug sim topped out at HR 169 against LTHR 178, with ZERO time in Z5 and a watch RPE of 4 against a planned 8. It confirmed pacing discipline but never tested recovery capability, because the SkiErg never created a debt to recover from.

THE ONE THING TO CHANGE: the SkiErg. Go one notch harder — target HR into the LOW 170s by the end of the ski, then hold run pace off it. That is the actual rehearsal of the Birmingham mechanism. Low 170s, not high 170s: the point is to arrive at the sled with a manageable debt and prove you can clear it, not to reproduce the failure.

RUN PACE: 5:25-5:35/km = 10.8-11.1 km/h, ~248-256W on Stryd at CP 261 (95-98%). START RUN 1 AT 10.8. On 8 Aug you started at 10.98 and the two slowest runs followed — 16s spread across four when the stated test was four flat. Four flat 5:33s beats a 5:28 followed by a 5:44. Cal factor still 101.7 so Stryd reads ~1.7% long; steer by the treadmill setting or by power, never by Stryd pace.

STATION EXPOSURE: 8 Aug logged SkiErg 3:10 / Sled Push 2:52 / Sled Pull 3:06 / BBJ 3:00 = 12:08 total. This week should read ~16:00. Log it — athletedata scores these minutes at ~0W and cannot see them.

prerun.text: PRE-RUN — ~9 min, in order. Spine-neutral throughout: no standing toe touches, no seated forward folds, no supine knees-to-chest. Press START on the first step, it auto-advances the whole routine.

prerun.label: Knee-to-wall dorsiflexion
prerun.detail: 10 reps/side, 2s hold at end range. Heel down, knee over 2nd toe. Switch at halfway. Note the L/R gap difference.

prerun.label: Ankle circles
prerun.detail: 20 each direction, both sides. Slow, full range.

prerun.label: Bent-knee heel raise
prerun.detail: 15 reps, 2s lower. Soleus — takes the running load, don't skip it.

prerun.label: Single-leg balance hold
prerun.detail: 20s on the weaker ankle only. Eyes open.

prerun.label: Half-kneeling hip flexor
prerun.detail: 30s/side. Squeeze the down-leg glute, tuck the pelvis. Do NOT arch the back to feel it.

prerun.label: 90/90 hip switches
prerun.detail: 8 slow reps. Sit tall, hands behind, chest up. Stop short if the low back rounds to get there.

prerun.label: Leg swings (wall support)
prerun.detail: 12 front/back then 12 lateral per side. Small range first 4, then build. Swing from the hip, trunk braced.

prerun.label: Glute bridge
prerun.detail: 15 reps, 2s squeeze at top, ribs down.

prerun.label: Banded lateral walk
prerun.detail: 10 steps each direction x2. Band above knees, soft knees, no torso lean.

prerun.label: Pogo hops
prerun.detail: 2 x 15. Stiff ankles, minimal knee bend, short ground contact. SKIP on easy days or if flat.
